[Act: contract
 Chapter: Of the Performance of Contracts
 Section: 66::Mode of communicating or revoking rescission of voidable contract.
]


The rescission of a voidable contract may be communicated or revoked in the same manner, and subject to the same rules, as apply to the communication or revocation of a proposal1.

metadata.section_title: Mode of communicating or revoking rescission of voidable contract.
